title: Status Check
description: See what is going on with orders right now: every order in the statuses you pick that changed within the chosen time, most recently updated first.
liveApiRequired: This page only works with the "Live API" data source (see Settings).
search: Search by phone number, customer name or order number
noOrders: No orders in the selected statuses and time frame.
noSearchMatches: No loaded order matches this search.
rangeAll: All orders currently in these statuses (no time limit)
